_meta.notes: WRONG YEAR IN THE SIGNATURE DATE: the filer wrote '2-2-08', but this is the year-end report for 2008 filed in 2009 - the Summary Page's own Date of Report box reads 'Feb. 2/09' and the clerk stamp is FEB 2 2009. The written date is recorded verbatim. Neither amendment box is checked. Column B is blank on both Lines 1 and 2. Cents are raised superscripts (dashes and raised 00s). Arithmetic consistent (32,098.00 + 21,575.00 = 53,673.00; minus 26,860.16 = 26,812.84), and Line 3 matches Line 7 of his October 28 interim report (key e7a1ba89).

expenditures.detail: exact (26,860.16 = 26,860.16) across 15 rows on p4, matching both the schedule's own printed TOTAL and Summary Page line 2 Column A

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: Neither attachment page prints a SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE - each is a one-page spreadsheet ('Page: 1 of 1') printing a single TOTAL row. itemized.escalation_note: p3 compact verification band at 600 dpi (name columns spliced against the Occupation+Contributed columns, empty address columns removed, ~2.5x base effective dpi) - fired specifically to settle the field-shift question below; p4 full-table crop at 600 dpi (~2.2x base).
itemized.notes: 4-page filing: p1 cover (January-31 year-end box checked, Council At Large, Democrat, signed '2-2-08' on a report the clerk received 2009-02-02 - a filer year typo kept verbatim, and a totals-tranche observation), p2 Summary Page, p3 and p4 the filer's own LANDSCAPE spreadsheets (rotated 90 deg COUNTER-clockwise to read - the opposite sign from the other landscape attachment in this chunk). The printed forms' own Schedule A/B pages are NOT in this document; the spreadsheets stand in for them. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN - THIS FILING NEEDED IT: on both pages the right-hand amount column's cell rules sit about HALF A ROW LOWER than the left-hand name rows, so at a glance each amount looks like it belongs to the row below. It does not. Three independent checks: (1) the row COUNTS match exactly (24 names / 24 amounts on p3; 15 descriptions / 15 amounts on p4); (2) the two filled Occupation cells ('President', 'Attorney') sit level with the amounts and with the correct person rows (Deseelhorst, Berman) - an internal alignment marker; (3) both TOTALS gate exactly. Pairing is 1:1 in printed order. Schedule A CARRIES NO DATE COLUMN AT ALL (Last / First / Address / City / State / Zip / Occupation and Employer / Contributed), so every contribution date is honestly blank - no date was inferred from the reporting period. Schedule B carries no Purpose column either (Date / Description / amount). p4's heading prints 'Schedule A' with a separate 'B' typed beside it and the subtitle 'Itemized Expenditures Made' - the filer reused the Schedule A template and corrected the letter; it is the expenditure schedule.
